name: codex-commit
description: Generate commit messages and branch names from your Git diff with Codex, right inside VS Code.

enumDescriptions: Default (Codex CLI default; effort also uses codex CLI/model default)
Most capable model for complex reasoning, coding, computer use, and research. Effort: low, medium, high, xhigh, max, ultra.
Flagship GPT-5.6 model for complex coding, computer use, research, and cybersecurity. Effort: low, medium, high, xhigh, max, ultra.
Balanced GPT-5.6 model for everyday work. Effort: low, medium, high, xhigh, max, ultra.
Fast and affordable GPT-5.6 model for clear, repeatable work. Effort: low, medium, high, xhigh, max.
Previous-generation frontier model for complex coding, computer use, knowledge work, and research. Effort: low, medium, high, xhigh.
Text-only research preview for near-instant coding iteration. Available to ChatGPT Pro users. Effort: low, medium, high, xhigh.
codexCommit.model.description: Model name passed to `codex exec --model`. Availability depends on your account, sign-in method, and Codex CLI version.

enumDescriptions: Default (do not pass effort; use codex CLI/model default)
Low — fast responses with lighter reasoning (all listed models)
Medium — balanced speed and reasoning depth (all listed models)
High — greater reasoning depth (all listed models)
Extra high — for difficult, multi-step work (all listed models)
Maximum reasoning depth (GPT-6 Astra and GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna only)
Maximum reasoning with automatic task delegation (GPT-6 Astra and GPT-5.6 Sol and Terra only)
codexCommit.effort.description: Reasoning effort passed via `codex exec -c model_reasoning_effort=...`. Empty keeps codex CLI default.

codexCommit.commitMessagePromptTemplate.default:
You are a senior engineer.
Generate a git commit message based ONLY on the staged diff.

Output format:
1) First line: Conventional Commits (feat|fix|refactor|docs|test|chore|perf|build|ci)(optional scope): subject (<= 72 chars)
2) Blank line
3) Bullet points (optional)

Staged diff:
{{diff}}
codexCommit.commitMessagePromptTemplate.description: Prompt template used only for commit-message generation. Use {{diff}} to insert the staged diff.

codexCommit.branchNamePromptTemplate.default:
You are a senior engineer.
Generate a concise git branch name based ONLY on the provided git diff.

Rules:
- Output one branch name only, with no explanation.
- Use lowercase.
- Use kebab-case.
- Prefer prefixes like feat/, fix/, chore/, docs/, refactor/, test/.

Diff:
{{diff}}
codexCommit.branchNamePromptTemplate.description: Prompt template used only for branch-name generation. Use {{diff}} to insert staged and unstaged diffs.

codexCommit.codexPath.description: Path to the Codex CLI in the extension host environment. Leave empty to use PATH resolution.

codexCommit.debugLog.description: Write sanitized process diagnostics and Codex stdout/stderr to the 'Codex Commit' output channel.

scripts.test: npm run compile && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:extension:min && npm run test:extension:stable
